To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cloud application platforms can be treated and managed as sensor networks, and that such treatment is beneficial for both cloud application platforms and their end-users.
cloud application platforms are sensor networks, and the cloud is a big data problem.
the cloud application platform monitoring can be seen as a special case of the more generic domain of sensor networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a self-managing cloud application platform.
the design of a novel approach for run-time monitoring of cloud application platforms.
the design of a monitoring system for cloud application platforms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented vision has a potential to become a new approach to cloud application platform monitoring, which is worth investigating further.
the vision is promising, yet it is too early to draw final conclusions.
we are still far away from a fully autonomous cloud application platform.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cloud application platforms can be seen as sensor networks, and that the monitoring of such platforms can be performed in the same manner as in the case of sensor networks.
we have presented a new way of thinking about cloud monitoring and we have demonstrated that the sensor network paradigm is a suitable model for cloud application platform monitoring.
the presented vision is not a new idea but rather an attempt to bring together different concepts and ideas into a coherent framework for cloud application platforms monitoring.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cloud application platform monitoring is a complex task that can benefit from the experience and knowledge accumulated by the research community in the sensor networks domain.
the cloud computing domain can benefit from the experience and solutions developed for sensor networks.
the sensor network vision can be used to develop a new class of monitoring solutions for cloud application platforms.
